plugins.name: shesha-developer
plugins.description: Shesha backend development toolkit with skills for creating entities, database migrations, and module projects following DDD patterns and framework conventions. Includes shesha-upgrade-reconciler for reconciling form configuration after a framework upgrade (version-aware rule packs, ledger, defect register, retire of fixed workarounds).

plugins.name: framework-dev
plugins.description: Skills for developers working on the Shesha framework itself (not application developers). Covers framework-level concerns such as authoring core designer components and running the Shesha backend locally for framework development on macOS.

plugins.name: shesha-developer-0-43
plugins.description: Version-pinned skill set for the v0.43 release of the Shesha framework. Mirrors the full historical toolkit — domain modeling, application layer, configuration items, workflow, document generation, reference numbers, notifications, integration testing, project setup, permission hardening, form cleanup, and analyzers — plus the design pipeline (shesha-claude-designer, shesha-design-comprehension, shesha-form-edit, shesha-design-system, clean-form-config) rewritten for the 0.43 versioned-ConfigurationItem form lifecycle. Supports building and maintaining legacy v0.43 projects.

plugins.name: shesha-developer-0-46
plugins.description: Version-pinned design and form pipeline for the v0.46 release of the Shesha framework: shesha-claude-designer, shesha-design-comprehension, shesha-design-system (Ant Design 6 theming), shesha-form-edit (0.46 form API, render-migration hazards, reworked components), clean-form-config and create-crud-form, plus the form-author, form-auditor, fleet-transformer, design-critic, fullstack-prereq-checker and reconciliation-assessor agents. Component knowledge is extracted from release-0.46.0; fleet-wide fixes for the 0.46 render hazards are packaged as rules in shesha-developer:shesha-upgrade-reconciler.
